remarks: Welcome to Heights Crossing, Darien's premier luxury apartment community, ideally located directly across from the Metro North station. This newly constructed 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath residence offers refined design, modern finishes, and exceptional convenience in a vibrant coastal setting.  The open-concept living and dining area is framed by oversized bay windows that flood the space with natural light. The designer kitchen features Quartz countertops, GE appliances, a bar-height island, and custom cabinetry all perfect for both entertaining and everyday living. This ADA-compliant unit also includes lowered countertops for accessibility. The wide layout offers clear turning space for mobility aids.  The primary bedroom suite boasts his-and-hers walk-in closets and a full bath with a sleek zero-threshold walk-in shower. The second bedroom, with its own walk-in closet and adjacent full bath, is ideal as a guest room, home office, or flexible space. A stylish powder room adds additional convenience for guests.  Additional highlights include a stacked in-unit washer and dryer, luxury wood-inspired tile flooring, enhanced soundproofing, and elevator access. Residents enjoy a beautifully landscaped courtyard, on-site retail, and walkable access to shopping, dining, beaches, and parks. Heights Crossing offers sophisticated coastal living with unbeatable commuter access.
